timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,500–1,550 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is at a 28-year weak point, with the Q2 average breaking 1,500 KRW/USD for the first time since the 1998 IMF crisis. Multiple sources indicate the rate is threatening 1,550, driven by hawkish Fed policy and foreign investor exodus, meaning you are paying significantly more won per dollar than historical norms.

TIP: If possible, consider staggering your $2,000 purchase across multiple dates within the month rather than converting in one lump sum, to average out the current unfavorable rates.
